# BTicino C300X Integration v2.1.0b1

## 2026-11-07

Opt-in beta for the native C300X display, preserving the original blue design.
Stable remains 2.0.0; this prerelease does not replace GitHub Latest.

## Alarmo

- Keeps the original blue design and the Alarmo subpage. Return after standby
  continues to follow your configuration.
- Shows the PIN keypad only when required, including entry delay. Modes without
  a PIN start directly. Pending commands block repeat taps.
- Preserves the chosen mode during PIN entry, clears PINs when leaving the page,
  and ignores late replies. Unavailable alarm data is shown as offline.
- The additional action is optional and configurable through **Alarm page entity**.
  Leave it empty to hide it, or explicitly select a stair-light button or another
  supported HA entity. Existing selected entities are retained.

## Device Controls

- Direct light on/off, cover up/stop/down and climate temperature adjustment.
- Detail views expose supported brightness, Kelvin temperature, color, cover
  position/tilt, climate modes/presets and target ranges. Selects show actual
  options; numbers use HA bounds, step and unit. Sliders send only on release.
- Confirmed states, pending/error handling and event-driven selected-entity
  updates, including without Alarmo. No new regular device polling.

## Notifications and Calendar

- HA automations can create, replace and remove bounded display notifications
  with stable IDs, priority and expiry. Details open only on tap; no automatic
  overlay or display wake. Up to two existing allowlisted actions are supported.
- The calendar-reminder blueprint uses existing HA calendars with a configurable
  lead time, text and expiry. No new calendar provider or device archive.
- Notifications live in HA memory and are cleared on HA restart/integration
  reload. Marking one read does not resolve the underlying physical condition.

## Display Settings

- Page assignment, per-page entity positions, names and secondary lines use the
  normal HA dialogs. Existing selections remain valid.
- The optional Alarmo quick action can be named without adding it to the overview.
  A visual editor remains deferred.

## Other Changes Since 2.0.0

- Card options independently hide/show the door and staircase-light buttons;
  narrow cards keep their controls aligned when labels wrap.
- Optional native HA camera microphone support on HA 2026.11+, off by default.
  Requires the integration option, HA Labs Two-way audio, WebRTC, HTTPS and
  microphone permission. Existing card talkback is unchanged.
- Fix transient media Repairs at restart, pending camera setup cleanup, message
  refresh races and incorrect successful display callback responses.
- Harden native rebuild/ABI checks and isolate test mocks. Separate camera
  ownership, display callback transport and native update-file handling.

## Upgrade and Testing

- Includes a freshly rebuilt native agent **2.1.0b1**. Update the agent and apply
  the Display patch for the new native pages. Applying the patch restarts the GUI.
- Local regression tests cover command handling and stale replies. Native device
  layout, standby return and interruption by a physical Ring Call still require
  beta confirmation; this build has not been installed on the device here.
- Home Assistant 2026.7 remains the minimum; standard validation covers 2026.10.
  Prereleases are opt-in and do not replace GitHub Latest.
